mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPI increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with declining RSAFS, or the correlation between RSAFS decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with increasing INDPRO, or the correlation between INDPRO increase and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8%, it signals a severe demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of HOUST decline and high UNRATE on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing at an annualized rate of more than 3%, it signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of strong PAYEMS and low UNRATE on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals a weakening supply-side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of low GDPC1 growth and flat/declining INDPRO on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
